import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def run(fn,n,starts=40):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(1); best=None
    for s in range(starts):
        q=rng.normal(0,1,n)
        try: r_=least_squares(lambda p: fn(p,t,A)-dA_dt,q,max_nfev=2000)
        except Exception: continue
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(r_.fun)): continue
        if best is None or r_.cost<best.cost: best=r_
    return round(np.mean(best.fun**2)/np.var(dA_dt),6), np.round(best.x,3)
